checks.detail: Rhai Code and Visual Graph tabs are independently clickable after the child editor is constrained below the mode bar.
Created a visual graph, searched and created Input Pressed, duplicated a selected node, added a variable/comment and used graph-local Undo without triggering project Undo.
Added Script2D to Main Camera, selected a .nova-graph asset, entered Play and observed 'Main Camera: Hello from Nova Visual Script' in the Script console with no browser error.
English, German and Chinese graph chrome rendered without document overflow, toolbar overflow or accidental panel overlap at 1280x720.
At 1024x640 palette becomes a bounded left drawer while canvas/details remain adjacent; at 720x640 palette/details become bounded drawers, minimap hides and the document remains overflow-free.
A new default graph restores its saved 100% viewport and both 224px nodes remain fully inside the 656px desktop canvas.
No console error or warning was captured during creation, localization, responsive resize, Script2D attachment, play or stop.

issuesFoundAndCorrected: ScriptStudio's absolute root covered the logic-mode tab hit target.
Graph-local Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+S, Ctrl/Cmd+D and Delete also reached global editor shortcuts.
Opening a graph discarded its serialized viewport and initial frame calculation could clip the right node.
Script2D's asset label and component summary incorrectly implied Rhai-only attachment.
